ammonia.reason: Short 5-8 day PGI minimum limits casein deamination and yeast urease NH3 accumulation.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized milk and no Brevibacterium linens washed rind limits p-cresol, indole and skatole.

bitter.reason: Very short proteolysis limits hydrophobic bitter peptides and high fat masks bitterness.

blue_moldy.reason: White Penicillium camemberti plus Geotrichum only, no Penicillium roqueforti C7-C11 methyl ketones.

browning.reason: High 49% moisture and short age leave limited Maillard reactants despite residual lactose.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl and acetoin from Lactococcus diacetylactis citrate metabolism amplified by 39% milkfat cream.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Limited lipase release of free butyric C4 and hexanoic C6 acids due to young age and pasteurization.

creaminess.reason: Triple-cream >=72% fat-in-dry-matter emulsion and high moisture create spoonable mouth-coating fat phase.

crumbliness.reason: Unpressed lactic curd in continuous high-fat phase prevents calcium-crosslinked fracture.

firmness.reason: High moisture lactic weak gel deacidified by surface flora gives soft, almost spoonable paste.

floral_honey.reason: Trace 2-phenylethanol and phenylacetaldehyde from phenylalanine catabolism by starter yeasts.

fruity.reason: Low ethyl butanoate and ethyl hexanoate esterification by Geotrichum candidum and yeasts on young rind.

goaty.reason: Cow milk plus cow cream only, no goat-milk caproic, caprylic or 4-ethyloctanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Minimal Strecker 2-methylbutanal and 3-methylbutanal due to no propionibacteria and 1-week ripening.

melt.reason: High fat and demineralized lactic curd flows readily on heating despite intact young acid core.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol and 1-octen-3-one from Penicillium camemberti lipoxygenase on linoleic acid in bloomy rind.

oil_off.reason: Excess added cream free milkfat coalesces and leaks oil when heated.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make, no wood-smoke guaiacol or syringol phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from mesophilic lactic curd fermentation, partly neutralized by Penicillium deacidification.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading, no aligned demineralized casein network for fibrous stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Uncooked curd and low methionine catabolism limits methanethiol, DMS and methional.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose and sweet perception of milkfat and delta-lactones balances lactic acidity.

umami.reason: Low free glutamate from limited rennet and plasmin proteolysis in 8-day lactic triple-cream.
